Title: Azure Communication Services Calling SDK for Windows Apps in public preview

Body.Content:
Developers can now add voice and video calling capabilities from Azure Communication Services to their native applications that run on Microsoft Windows, enabling rich communication experiences for desktop PC, Xbox, Mixed-reality headset, HoloLens, IoT devices and more. 

Read the blog.
